//: any2bazel emit_build.py conventions for the freebsd-bzl workspace: the FreeBSD tree is the Bazel workspace (project root .), the kernel compiles with the pinned kernel_llvm toolchain through the layer's own rules (cc_per_source_library, freebsd_kernel_link, kernel_steps), host tools with the hermetic LLVM exec toolchain. This file is the record of the derivation facts the emitter consumes; the delivered sys BUILD files are the emitter's render -- a re-emit from the installed tree reproduces them byte-for-byte (proven in the 2026-10-28 run); only the workspace root is hand-curated (keep_files). Run the emitter in a scratch copy (a real copy, never a hardlink one): it writes and never deletes, and the layer's bazel-* convenience symlinks break its query. The 2026-10-28 run closes the emit-vs-layer delta: piece_shape routes each split piece's include surface through the layer's carriers (a fact the model cannot derive -- it records a compile's primary input only); keep_files keeps the hand-curated workspace root out of the emit.
